input: Write given/when/then specifications for a Screenplay slice.

assertions.value: Inline events are ordinary named facts
Look first for the project's existing `.play` files
`cratis ai install` manages `.cratis/ai/`, never model files
**`then` contains either events or an error — never both.**
only the asserted properties must match

Bare `then error` never matches
  a denial
**`when query` executed. The clock, trigger and capture actions did not.**
`then result` and `then no result` need `when query`
A clock instant is ISO 8601 with an offset or `Z`
one rejection specification per concept rule
